cv_sections.summary:
Game Developer & XR Designer | Interactive Systems | Research-
Driven Innovation
Game Developer and Designer with a background in Computer
Engineering, bringing together technical precision and creative vision
to build interactive experiences across education, research, and
applied gaming.
Over the past few years, I’ve contributed to and led development
on several cross-disciplinary XR, AI, and web projects, delivering
impactful tools in fields ranging from civil engineering and space
science to defense training and immersive education. My work
includes simulation-based training, game-based learning platforms,
and award-winning prototypes developed in collaboration with
esteemed research and government organizations.
Skilled in Unity, Unreal Engine, WebGL, XR, AI, and cross-
platform deployment, I focus on building scalable, research-
backed systems that enhance engagement, retention, and learning
outcomes validated through biometric testing, studies, and real-world
implementation.
I thrive in agile, collaborative environments and bring a systems-
thinking mindset to every stage of development, from gameplay
design to technical architecture.
Currently open to opportunities that allow me to push the boundaries
of interactive storytelling, game-based learning, and immersive
technology.
Explore my portfolio: shripadagashe.com
  Page 1 of 4
   
Reach out: shripad.agashe.business@gmail.com
